solves.reasoning: we are ___ by others=accepted; the yearning is ___=strong; feel a little bit ___=special → accepted-strong-special
we are ___=normal; recognized as ___=individuals; want to be ___ and believed in=visible → normal-individuals-visible
We all ___ to feel=desire; personally ___=significant; identities to be ___=honoured → desire-significant-honoured
② shows 'weak' but the yearning is described as strong; weak contradicts 'strain equally'
③ shows 'invisible' but we want to be visible / not overlooked; invisible is opposite
① shows 'rejected' but we fit in and are accepted by others; rejected is opposite
goal is to be accepted and NOT regarded as complete social ___ → outcasts
not wishing to be famous, rather want to avoid ___; visible/not overlooked → invisibility
recognized as ___, thought of as personally significant → individuals
AGENT: desire = want (바라다). avoid/forget/fear 부적합
AGENT: yearning(갈망) = longing. refusal/doubt/denial 부적합
AGENT: acknowledged(인정받는) = recognized. rejected/hidden/delayed 부적합
AGENT: accepted(받아들여지는) 반의어 = rejected. famous/honest/simple 다른 의미축
AGENT: significant(중요한) 반의어 = trivial. obvious/similar/distant 다른 의미축
AGENT: (A) stand up=서다, (B) stand out=두드러지다 → (A)서다-(B)두드러지다
AGENT: behaves in a strange/unusual way = eccentric(괴짜). admirer/celebrity/outcast 부적합
being + 과거분사(수동 동명사) → recognize가 recognized로
avoid의 목적어=명사 필요 → invisible(형용사)이 invisibility(명사)로
wish to ___ from the crowd and NOT merely blend in → stand out
